response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, cnt AS employee_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
